name: Blocking If-Else
hint: You are using [sbi]stop [all v][/sbi] or [sbi]stop [this script v][/sbi] blocks in both the [sbi]if :: #ffab19[/sbi] and [sbi]else :: #ffab19[/sbi] branch of this block. So the script terminates anyway and the blocks after the [sbi]if < > then[/sbi] are never executed.
instruction: Try using the stop command only in one branch or remove the blocks after the [sbi]if < > then[/sbi].

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching (bird v)> then
show
stop [this script v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
else
hide
stop [this script v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
end
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching (bird v)> then
show
stop [this script v] :: #007000 //⇦ 👍
else
hide
end
end
